result.topic_en: Calculations with Riemann's P-function expressed via a hypergeometric-type function, listing exponent combinations under sign changes and the substitution x -> 1-x, and deriving linear relations between P-functions about x and 1-x with sine/cosine coefficients.
result.transcription:
$P(a,b,c,x) = x^{\frac{a}{2}+\frac12}(1-x)^{\frac{b}{2}+\frac12}\,\mathfrak{F}\left(\frac{a+b+c-1}{2},\frac{a-b-c-1}{2},\frac{c-b-a-1}{2},x\right)$
$P(a,b,c,x)$ \quad $a+b+c,\ a-b-c$
$P(-a,b,-c,x)$ \quad [-$a-b-c$-] $-a+b-c\ \ -a-b+c$
$P(b,a,c,1-x)$ \quad $b+a+c\ \ b-a-c$
$P(-b,a,-c,1-x)$ \quad $-b+a-c\ \ -b-a+c$

$P(a,b,c,x)\sin v\pi + \sin\left(v+\frac{a+b+c-1}{2}\right)\pi\cdot P(b,a,c,1-x) + \sin(v+b-1)\pi\, P(-a,+b,+c,x)$
$+\sin\left(v+\frac{a-b-c-1}{2}\right)\pi\, P(-b,-a,+c,1-x)$
$P(a,b,c,x)\sin\left(v-\frac{b+\frac{c-1}{2}}{2}\right)\pi + \sin\left(v+\frac{a+\frac{c-1}{2}}{2}\right)$ [-$\sin$-] $P(b,a,c,1-x)$ .
$+\sin\left(v\pm\frac{-b+\frac{c-1}{2}}{2}\right)\pi$
$P(a,b,c,x)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\left(b+\frac{c-1}{2}\right)-v\right) = P(b,a,c,1-x)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\left(a+\frac{c-1}{2}\right)+v\right)$
$\pm P(-a,-b,c,x)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\left(-b+\frac{c-1}{2}\right)-v\right) \pm P(-b,-a,c,1-x)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\left(-a+\frac{c-1}{2}\right)+v\right)$
.....
$\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\left(b+\frac{c}{2}-v-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$ \quad $\sin\left(a+\frac{c}{2}+v-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$
$\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\left(b-\frac{c}{2}+v+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$ \quad $\sin\left(a-\frac{c}{2}\pm v+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$

$P(a,b,c,x)\sin\frac{\pi}{2}\left(b+\frac{c-1}{2}-v\right) - P(-a,-b,c,x)\frac{\pi}{2}\left(-b+\frac{c-1}{2}-v\right)$

$P$

$P(a,b,c,x)\sin b\pi = \sin\frac{a-b+c-1}{2}\pi\, P(b,a,c,1-x)$ [-$+\sin\frac{-a+b+c+1}{2}$-]
$= \sin\frac{-b+a+c-1}{2}\pi\, P(b,a,c,1-x) - \sin\frac{-b-a+c-1}{2}\pi\, P(-b,-a,c,1-x)$
[-$=\sin\frac{a+b-c+1}{2}\pi$-]
$= -\cos\frac{b-a-c}{2}\pi\, P(b,-a,-c,1-x) + \cos\frac{-b-a+c}{2}\pi\, P(-b,-a,c,1-x)$
$= \cos\frac{-b-a+c}{2}\pi\, P(-b,-a,c,1-x) - \cos\frac{b-a-c}{2}\pi\, P(b,-a,-c,1-x)$

$\sin a\pi\, P(b,a,c,1-x) = -P(a,-b,-c,x)\cos\frac{a-b-c}{2}\pi + \cos\frac{-a+b+c}{2}\pi\, P(-a,-b,c,x)$
$P(a,b,c,x) = K\cos\frac{a+b-c}{2}\pi\cos\frac{a-b+c}{2}\pi\, P(a,b,-c,x)$

methods.what: Representation of the P-function by a power factor times a hypergeometric series
Table of exponent combinations for the four related P-functions at x and 1-x
General linear relation with a free parameter v between P-functions about x and about 1-x
Connection formula expressing P(a,b,c,x) through P-functions in 1-x with trigonometric coefficients
Inverse connection formula for P(b,a,c,1-x) in terms of P-functions in x
Relation between P(a,b,c,x) and P(a,b,-c,x) with constant K and cosine factors
